title: LIVE DEMO: EDIT ONE ELEMENT

steps.label: 1 · PREPARE A SCRATCH COPY INSIDE THE REPO
steps.text: a fixture under /tmp is refused as a symlink escape

steps.label: 2 · RENDER THE BEFORE
steps.text: PNG and SVG into an immutable run folder

steps.label: 3 · EDIT TWO FIELDS, SAVE, RENDER THE AFTER
steps.text: --set edits are schema-validated; --save writes the fixture only after the render and export succeed

steps.label: 4 · RERENDER AND COMPARE HASHES
steps.text: the saved fixture renders to the same SVG bytes

watch: What to watch: only the headline text and the primary color change. Every other element stays byte-identical, and the after and again SVGs hash the same.
env: Node 22.2 or newer (verified on v26.0.0; Node 18 fails on node:zlib crc32). Dependencies: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile.
